enchantments.tooltip: +1 Enhancement Bonus: +1 enhancement bonus to Armor Class, attack and damage rolls.
Hallowed: An item with this quality assists only wearers who have the ability to turn undead. Hallowed items provide an +1 Enhancement bonus to the maximum Hit Dice of undead turned.
Sacred +1: An item with this quality assists only wearers who have the ability to turn undead. Sacred items provide an +1 Enhancement bonus to your effective level for Turning Undead.

enchantments.text: Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4 and/or Mythic Shield Boost +2 or +4
enchantments.tooltip: Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)Mythic Shield Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
